title: Remove Body::Comet / CometId — unbacked API surface, pre-1.0 cleanup
description:
# Remove Body::Comet / CometId — unbacked API surface, pre-1.0 cleanup

## Summary
C 2.10.03 has NO real comet backend behind SE_COMET_OFFSET for swe_calc — comet-like bodies come through fictitious elements in seorbel.txt instead (`Body::Fictitious`). Our `Body::Comet(CometId)` is speculative surface with nothing behind it (falls through to the error path today). Decision on swisseph-rs/121: remove it rather than ship dead enum variants in a 1.0 API; adding variants back later is non-breaking under the crate's enum evolution strategy.

All references are confirmed confined to three files (verified by grep 2026-07-03: zero hits in calc/context/tests/README).

## Steps
1. `src/types.rs`: remove `CometId` struct + impl (lines ~60–75), `Body::Comet` variant, `Body::comet()` constructor, the `to_raw_id` arm, the `TryFrom<i32>` arm `1000..=8999` — that range must now yield `Err(InvalidBody)`; make sure it doesn't accidentally fall into the `n >= AST_OFFSET` asteroid arm (it can't, 8999 < 10000, but add the explicit test). Remove the `CometId` unit tests; add `Body::try_from(5000).is_err()` and `Body::try_from(1000).is_err()`.
2. `src/constants.rs`: remove `COMET_OFFSET` (line ~114).
3. `src/lib.rs`: remove `CometId` from the re-export list (line ~51).
4. Grep `docs/` + README for comet mentions; if a not-ported list mentions comets, reword to: comets are not a real swe_calc backend in C 2.10 — use `Body::Fictitious` with seorbel.txt elements for comet-like bodies. (The README not-ported line itself is otherwise Polish 5/7's territory — only touch wording that would become false after this removal.)
5. `cargo test` + `cargo clippy --all-targets` — no golden data changes expected.

## Acceptance criteria
- `CometId`/`Comet` absent from the crate; `Body::try_from` of 1000..=8999 errors.
- Full test suite + clippy pass unchanged otherwise.
